WITH sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number AS cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk AS cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_sales_price AS cs_sales_price,
        i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        w.w_state AS w_state,
        d.d_date AS d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
      AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-04-02' AND DATE '2001-06-01'
)
SELECT
    sb.w_state,
    sb.i_item_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(sb.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)) FILTER (WHERE sb.d_date < DATE '2001-05-02'), 0) AS sales_before,
    COALESCE(SUM(sb.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)) FILTER (WHERE sb.d_date >= DATE '2001-05-02'), 0) AS sales_after
FROM sales_base sb
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = sb.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = sb.cs_item_sk
GROUP BY sb.w_state, sb.i_item_id
ORDER BY sb.w_state, sb.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
